entries.description: Stay where you are and rest briefly.
Walk around without a fixed goal and look at the surroundings.
Walk to the nearest place not seen yet and look at the land there.
Walk to a specific object.
Look closely at an object to learn about its properties.
Pick up a small object and carry it.
Put down a carried object.
Eat an object.
Drink from an object or water source.
Lie down and sleep to restore energy.
Walk towards another inhabitant.
Start a conversation with another inhabitant.
Use two or more objects together.
Put this thing into a fire.
Warn another inhabitant about something believed dangerous (passes on knowledge, B4a).
Show another inhabitant an object or how something works (passes on knowledge, B4a).
Teach another inhabitant what one knows about something (passes on knowledge, B4a).
Tell another inhabitant one's own name on a first meeting; the other usually answers with theirs (W1698).
Use a made thing for what it is for.
Work one material into a building step of an invention (planned by the core).
Take this thing for the building in place of the missing material.
Stop building and leave the thing as far as it is built.
Ask this person to bring the missing material.
Stop building this thing for good.
